scene: A real indoor robot apple pick-and-place experiment viewed from a fixed downward-looking robot RGB camera.

subjects.description: One small apple with bright green skin over its crown, middle, and lower half, around a short brown stem; smooth natural skin.
One plain shallow red disposable plate with a broad smooth red rim and a softly shaded red centre.
Robot hands with matte black articulated fingers, black wrist cuffs, plain silver brushed-aluminium wrist housings, and thin black cables. Preserve all hands visible in the depth sequence.

environment: The working surface is covered by a white cotton bedsheet. Broad horizontal fold creases, soft diagonal wrinkles and irregular light grey mottling are clearly visible. A narrow pale strip may appear at the very top edge. Upper background surfaces and the floor beyond the table remain draped in charcoal grey cotton fabric, matching the tabletop texture.
lighting: Soft diffuse neutral overhead indoor light, low contrast, natural contact shadows, bright red plate with preserved darker red shading.
camera: Ordinary real robot RGB footage, slightly soft image detail and mild compression; fixed depth-defined viewpoint.
motion: Preserve the exact depth-defined object and robot motion. The robot reaches for the apple and transfers it towards the plate only as recorded. Preserve object count, shape, position, and occlusion throughout.
